ns2:section.sectionText: On Thursdays, this online section will meet live with the in person section via Zoom and classroom microphones and camera. Students in this section will watch a recording of the Tuesday meeting asynchronously. Online scheduled class sessions require each student to have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. Wireless internet is NOT recommended. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see https://online.illinois.edu. This course requires the following textbook: W.H. Schlesinger and Emily S. Bernhardt, Title: Biogeochemistry: An Analysis of Global Change (3rd edition) ISBN: either 978-0123858740 or 0123858747.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
